purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The Kerala Department’s official e-Maps link points to emaps.kerala.gov.in, but requests timed out and the TLS certificate validation failed. No TLS bypass was used, so viewer JS, service schema, and parcel geometry were not verified. Whether the official e-Maps service is temporarily unavailable or whether another official endpoint serves the same city-specific cadastral map; parcel coverage at the WUP point remains unknown.
registryAssessment: Kerala’s Directorate of Survey and Land Records operates BhuNaksha/eMaps, and its official description says citizens can obtain digital sketches for parcels in mapped villages. The official DSLR directory lists Thrissur district survey and mapping offices. This confirms local survey/cadastral functions, but not point-specific coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Kerala eMaps page describes cadastral mapping by village and says citizens can obtain a digital sketch of each parcel in a village.
Official Kerala BhuNaksha viewer page for state code 32; UI presents district/taluk/village selection and plot information.
